thesis: Mohnish Pabrai describes his journey from having no understanding of investing to discovering value investing through Peter Lynch and Warren Buffett after reading their books on a flight in 1994. He argues that the laws of investing, such as concentrated portfolios and buy-and-hold strategies, function like the laws of physics and that the mutual fund industry was diametrically opposed to these principles, resulting in poor performance.
